info.title: Grounding Service
info.description: This service allows you to upload PDF files to generate and store semantic embeddings, enabling context-aware, and data-grounded AI responses. It also provides functionality to delete stored embeddings, ensuring content relevance and data manageability. It enhances the interaction by making the content of the PDF more accessible to the agent. The service is vital in ensuring that the system can effectively understand and address user needs.

x-sap-shortText: The Grounding Service enables the creation and deletion of embeddings from PDF documents. These embeddings help agents respond to relevant user intents.

put.summary: Sends the content of a PDF file to an existing media resource.
put.description: Update an existing entity with the content of a text PDF file. Note that images and tables are not supported. Once completed, this update triggers the creation of embeddings for the file. These are saved in another entity, after which the current entity is deleted.

post.summary: Remove the embeddings for the given source and category.

value.example: 12 Embeddings for File openUtil.pdf were removed from DB.

name.description: Name of the data source (such as the file name).

category.description: Target Category for the Embeddings. The target category corresponds to an agent.
